sections.title: The Problem: Proximity vs. Privacy
lecture_lines: We must track exposure without identities.
Central servers should not track individuals.
animations: 1. Display proximity scenario with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/person.svg] (User A and User B) in white (#FFFFFF).
3. Highlight contact risk area in orange (#FFA500) around [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg].
4. Display privacy concern text (red #FF0000) over [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] user IDs.
5. Fade out all, ending with question mark in light blue (#00FFFF).

sections.title: Core Mechanism: Ephemeral Tracing Keys
lecture_lines: Phones generate secret Daily Tracing Keys.
animations: 1. Generate random daily key (color: #00FF00) for User A using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg].
2. Derive ephemeral tracing keys (color: #FFFF00) from daily key.
3. Show keys rotating (animation: rotate) in sequence.

sections.title: The Exchange: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Handshake
animations: 2. Visualize BLE signal strength as pulsing rings (#00FFFF) originating from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/device.svg].
3. Encrypt packet display using lock icon (color: #FFFFFF) above [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/phone.svg].

sections.title: Exposure Detection: The Decentralized Match
animations: 1. Central server [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/server.svg] publishes list of diagnosis keys (color: #FF0000).
2. Device [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] downloads list, matches against stored contact keys.
3. Highlight positive match (color: #00FF00) on user device [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg].
